Note.title: Note
Note.description: User note, code snippet, script, drawing, or photo note document

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the note author

title.description: Title of the note or script name

content.description: Markdown text, Python code, or note body

category.description: Category or folder name e.g. Python, General, Vault, KeepBackup

tags.description: User assigned tags for quick filtering

colorTheme.description: Cyberpunk color preset hex code or theme name

isVault.description: Whether the note is protected by PIN vault

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned at the top

drawingData.description: Serialized stroke data for hand-drawn notes

imageUrl.description: Base64 or URI of attached/edited image

noteType.description: Type of note: text, python, drawing, photo

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp; clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

updatedAt.description: Last updated timestamp; clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

JarvisMessage.title: JarvisMessage
JarvisMessage.description: Persistent chat message log with AI Assistant Jarvis

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

message.description: Message text in English, Hindi, or Hinglish

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences, hacker font selections, and vault configuration

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

fontFamily.description: Selected hacker or monospaced font family

fontSize.description: Selected font size e.g. SMALL, MEDIUM, LARGE, XL

vaultPin.description: Hashed or encoded 4-digit PIN for Secure Vault

geminiApiKey.description: Optional user-configured Gemini API Key for Jarvis AI assistant

/users/{userId}/notes/{noteId}.description: User notes, python scripts, drawings, photo notes, and Keep backup imports

/users/{userId}/jarvis_messages/{message.description: Synchronized conversation logs with AI Assistant Jarvis

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingsId}.description: User preferences, typography settings, and vault security
